bug_report:
coroutines: questionable handling of void get_return_object
morph_fn_to_coro includes the comment

      /* For class type return objects, we can attempt to construct,
         even if the gro is void.  */

I don't see anything in the standard to allow this.

Disabling that support breakspr96749-2.C,pr94879-folly-1.C,pr94883-folly-2.C, which all have void get_return_object() and a coroutine that returns non-void.  I believe this is the result of testcase reduction, not something that a user actually wrote.

Munging the second of those to appease clang gives the error I expect:https://godbolt.org/z/PTbsWf8hj<source>:50:3: error: no viable conversion from returned value of type 'void' to function return type 'n'
